title: How do I get a receipt or invoice for a Target.com purchase?

contents.content:
Transactions will be available within a few hours up to approximately two years. 

Target App
  1. Access the Target account tab in the app.
  2. Select Purchase history to locate your order.
  3. Select the order.
  4. Select Receipts.
  5. Select View.
  6. From there, you can: 
    • Present the barcode to Guest Services while returning an item.
    • Share gift receipt.

Target.com

  1. Access your Target account.
  2. Select Purchase History to locate your order.
  3. Select View order to find order details.
  4. Select Receipts and invoices.
    • For returns, present the barcode on your mobile device to Guest Services or select Print receipts.
    • To print a gift receipt, select Print gift receipt.
    • To review a detailed copy of your transaction, select View detailed invoices.


Remember to check the Target return policy to make sure the item is eligible for a return.
